title: Early Childhood Teacher
summary: Early childhood teachers help children up to about six years old learn through play, language and routine.
tasks: Observe and record each child's progress

routes.title: Certificate or diploma in early childhood education

title: Primary School Teacher
summary: Primary teachers teach reading, writing, maths and more to children, building the foundations for later learning.

title: Secondary School Teacher
summary: Secondary teachers teach one or two subjects to teenagers and prepare them for national exams.
tasks: Guide students on subject and career choices
subjects: The two subjects you want to teach

routes.title: Bachelor of Education or a degree plus a teaching diploma

title: University Lecturer
summary: Lecturers teach university students, supervise research and publish their own research.

title: Careers Counsellor
summary: Careers counsellors help students and adults understand their options and plan study and work.

routes.title: Degree in education, psychology or social sciences
